metaTitle: Azrug n ilfan — Hanibal, seg Ṛun ɣer idurar n Alpes (218 uqbel Ɛisa)
metaDesc: 37 n ilfan, 1 600 km, 15 wussan deg idurar n Alpes: tizrigt n Hanibal asuref s asuref, tihila n Ṛun, idiwenniyen ɣef uɣilif, taẓuri n ilfan n Qarṭaǧ akked Surus.
title: 37 n ilfan mgal idurar n Alpes
lede: Asif ameqqran, iɣilifen yeččuṛen d udfel, tuddar yesɛan ccḥen: axeddim ameqqran n tezrewt ur numid di zzman aqdim.
heroAlt: J. M. W. Turner — Asigna n udfel: Hanibal d uɛesskar-is zegren idurar n Alpes
heroCap: J. M. W. Turner — Asigna n udfel (1812)
nums.4.t: n ulqey ɣef uɣilif, akken i gettwafren uɣilif
introTitle: Ayen ur numid yuɣal d tidet
intro: Deg umwan n 218 uqbel Ɛisa, Hanibal Barka ixdem ayen Iṛumaniyen ḥesben d awezɣi: azger n idurar n Alpes s uɛesskar ummid akked ilfan-is n umennuɣ, akken ad yezger Italya seg ugafa. Tikli-agi n ugar n 1 600 n ikilumitren seg Qarṭaǧant teqqim d yiwen seg yimahilen n tezrewt d umennuɣ ibaṛazen aṭas deg umezruy.
rhone.title: Sseɣlin-asen belli d akal
rhone.text: Akken i d-yenna Bulib, iselmaden n lbenyan bnan tiɣelfin timeqqranin ɣummen s wakal, akken ilfan ad ḥesben ttazalen ɣef uglim. Mi ten-ssekcamen s uẕrar, kra fell-asent xuṣṣent ɣlint ɣer waman — maca akk fkant seld-as.
rhone.more: Ɣer webrid nniḍen, Igaliyen sṭeren abrid. Hanibal yuzen deg yiḏ Hanun, mmi-s n Bomilqar, akken ad yezger asif ɣer tazwara; mi d-yessken-d anzuy n usiḥ, aɛesskar yezger deg tɣelfin skud Hanun yeṭṭef Igaliyen seg deffir.
rhone.chips.1: Ɣer ukkuẕ n wussan n tikli seg lebḥer
trio.0.title: Lfil n Ugafa n Tafrikt
trio.0.text: Tirbaɛt tura temmut, meẕẕiyet ɣef lfil n lexla: ɣer 2,5 n yimitren ɣef taɣmart. Nettwali-t ɣef icikalen n Ibarkiyen.
trio.1.title: Times d lxell
trio.1.text: Ɣef leḥsab n Titus Livyus, aẓru yeɣli isṭer anzal; iɛeskriyen sseẖman aẓru s tmes sakin fesren-t s uskiḏew n lxell fell-as.
trio.2.title: Anwa uɣilif?
trio.2.text: Traversette, Mont-Cenis, Clapier, Petit-Saint-Bernard… Amtawi mazal-it yeldi; tisnalsas n wakal n tmeẕẕuɣin akka melmi ɣilent tikkelt-nniḍen ɣer Traversette.
routeSub: Seg Qarṭaǧant ɣer uzaɣaṛ n Pu — ɣef leḥsab n Bulib d Titus Livyus
route.0.text: Hanibal yeffeg seg Qart Ḥadasht s uɛesskar meqqer aṭas. Yeǧǧa gma-s Hasdrubal ad iḥader Ispanya.
route.1.text: Yesnuzget neɣ ileqqeb akked tuddar, yeǧǧa Hanun ad iḥadeṛ tamnaḏt s 11 000 n yergazen, yerra 11 000 n Iberiyen ɣer taddart-nsen axir ma ad yesḥess ɣef iɛeskriyen ur neqbil ara.
route.2.text: Tiɣelfin timeqqranin ɣummen s wakal i ilfan; aṭhur n uɛesskar izegren ɣer tazwara, ihudd Igaliyen seg deffir.
route.3.text: 9 wussan armi ɣer ugmuḍ: tuffriwin n tuddar n Alpes, aẓru yeɣli, iberdan iḥeṛcen d lǧamed amecṭaḥ. Ilfan ẖeṣren deg wakal iqeṛḥen.
route.4.text: Ɣer ugmuḍ, iskan i yiɛeskriyen-is ɛeyyun uzaɣaṛ n Pu, isseḥya ṭṭbiɛa-nsen. Asaruẓ, ɣef iberdan iǧmaden, yettuɣal d ahaḍaṛ ugar ɣef ulqey.
route.5.text: Seld 15 n wussan deg idurar n Alpes, aɛesskar yewweḍ ɣer uzaɣaṛ n Pu. Axsaṛan d ameqqran, maca Ṛuma tettwaḥsel: Italya tettwaxṣer s wakal.
mapSub: Ḏfeṛ tanekra n Hanibal seg Qarṭaǧant ɣer uzaɣaṛ n Pu, sakin ɣer Kannas d Zama.
war.0.title: Lfil yemmuten
war.0.text: Ahat d lfil n Ugafa n Tafrikt, tirbaɛt temmut (tettusemma tikwal Loxodonta africana pharaonensis), meẕẕiyet ɣef lfil n lexla: ɣer 2,5 n yimitren ɣef taɣmart. Addad-is ur yettwafran ara s ṣṣeḥ. Qarṭaǧ tezmer tesɛa daɣen kra n ilfan n Asya, i d-yusan seg Maṣer neɣ Suriya.
war.1.title: Ssuḏen send ad wten
war.1.text: Ilfan llant ɣer tazwara d laslaḥ n uẖuf: tawessart-nsent tesseṭṭaḥ iɛeskriyen uḍaren tesseḥzen iyisan ur numin ara aked-sent. Yal yiwen yettwanhad sɣur bu lfil. Tigejda n yimcetliyen, yellan mliḥ ɣer ilfan n Lhend n yigelliden ihilinistiyen, qqiment d askik ɣer win n Qarṭaǧ, imeẕẕiyen ugar.
war.2.title: Surus
war.2.text: Katun Amɣar, yettwabedren sɣur Plin, yeḥfeḏ isem n lfil win yesɛan ugar n taẓɣelt deg uɛesskar apunik: Surus, « Asiri », win yesɛan ala yiwen n uɣsan n uẖenneq. Ɣef leḥsab n Titus Livyus, Hanibal yezger igelman n Arnu deg tefsut n 217, yuli ɣef lfil aneggaru i yettɣiman — tikwal yettwaqeṛṛeb ɣer Surus.
war.3.title: Yettɣima zdat idurar n Alpes, mačči zdat tegrest
war.3.text: Ugar n ilfan deg 37 ttɣiment seld tizrigt, ttnaɣent di Trebya, deg duǧembeṛ 218. Maca adfel, agefur d ssmerd n tegrest-agi sseẖsaren-tent: ɣef leḥsab n Bulib, yiwet kan i d-yeqqimen. Deg 215, Bomilqar issers-d 40 n ilfan d talɣayt di Lukri; di Zama, deg 202, Hanibal yeseglem 80.
war.4.title: Ticmeɛt n zzman aqdim
war.4.text: Idrimen iqarṭaǧiyen, akked wid i ssnulfan Ibarkiyen di Ispanya, skanen aṭas n ilfan. Tugna n Hanibal akked ilfan-is i yezegren idurar n Alpes tuɣal d yiwet seg ticmaɛ ibaṛazen aṭas n zzman aqdim, yettwaxeddem sɣur Goya, Turner d waṭas nniḍen.
battles.0.name: Tessinu
battles.0.text: Amenɣi amezwaru: iɛeskriyen inumidiyen ɣef wuyis seṭṭaren wid n Publius Cornelius Scipiyun, yettwajreḥ. Mmi-s n 17 iseggasen, d Scipiyun Afriki ara d-yilin, isellek tudert-is.
battles.1.name: Trebya
battles.1.text: Deg wul n tegrest, Hanibal yesnuzget ilijyun n Sempronyus ad zegren asif ijamden; gma-s Magun, yeffer akked 2 000 n yergazen, yehudd-iten seg deffir.
battles.2.name: Agelmam n Trasimen
battles.2.text: Aɛesskar n uqunṣul Flaminyus yettwaṭṭef ger agelmam d yidurar: deg tlata isragen, 15 000 n Iṛumaniyen ttwanɣan, 6 000 ttwaṭṭfen.
battles.3.name: Kannas
battles.3.text: S 50 000 n yergazen mgal 86 000 n Iṛumaniyen, Hanibal ixdem snat n tɣelfin yettwaẕẕayen. Ger 50 000 d 70 000 n Iṛumaniyen mmuten, gar-asen 80 n yimeqqranen n Usqamu.
tactText: Trebya, Trasimen, Kannas asuref s asuref akked Zama: tazrawt n tɣawsiwin i yesnefrent amezruy.

links.0.text: Seg Qarṭaǧant ɣer Zama, tudert n unmhal i gesseẖzen Ṛuma.
links.1.title: Imenɣan ipunikiyen
links.1.text: Tlata n imenɣan, aqeṛn n umennuɣ ɣef Agaraw Alemmas.
links.2.title: Aɛesskar n Qarṭaǧ
links.2.text: Tarbaɛt tamqeddest, Ilibiyen, Inumidiyen, imcetliyen d ilfan.
links.3.title: Qarṭaǧ d Agaraw Alemmas
links.3.text: Tamura, tanekra n Hanibal, tirzigin d imɛawanen.
